from langfuse import observe

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_async_generator_without_output_capture_does_not_set_output_attribute(langfuse_memory_client: Any, memory_exporter: Any) -> None:
    @observe(name="async_gen", capture_output=False)
    async def async_gen():
        for i in range(2):
            yield f"item_{i}"

    # Consume the async generator fully
    result = []
    async for item in async_gen():
        result.append(item)
    assert result == ["item_0", "item_1"]

    # Flush spans to the exporter
    langfuse_memory_client.flush()

    # The span should exist but must NOT have OBSERVATION_OUTPUT attribute
    spans = [s for s in memory_exporter.get_finished_spans() if s.name == "async_gen"]
    assert len(spans) == 1
    span = spans[0]
    from langfuse._client.attributes import LangfuseOtelSpanAttributes
    assert LangfuseOtelSpanAttributes.OBSERVATION_OUTPUT not in span.attributes"
}
